verdict.rationale: Clerky ships an official remote MCP server that lets users of Claude, ChatGPT and other assistants work with Clerky through natural-language requests. A live probe confirmed the server is up and OAuth-gated. The probe notes the tools are read-only and team-scoped, so natural language can query Clerky but apparently not operate it (create or modify document sets, sign, file). Clerky also has no built-in natural-language interface of its own. Missing for 10: write/action tools via natural language, a native in-product natural-language interface, a documented tool list and scope, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Once connected, the assistant can use available Clerky MCP tools with the team access you authorize.
live OAuth-gated remote MCP server, per docs read-only tools with team-scoped access
